Manolis Marazakis - RISER project: Developing a European, energy-efficient cloud infrastructure based on open-source RISC-V technology to strengthen Europe's digital autonomy. Susana Otero Belmar - AI-TranspWood project: Using artificial intelligence and advanced modelling to develop sustainable transparent wood materials with potential applications in construction, automotive, electronics and other industries. Jorge Fernandes - GreenChips-EDU project
